title: God of My Life, Thy Boundless Grace
description: God of My Life, Thy Boundless Grace in Tonic Solfa to JUST AS I AM, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Charlotte Elliott wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 265.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked 8.8.8.6, to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to JUST AS I AM; any other 8.8.8.6 tune fits them as well.
underlay: God of my life, Thy bound-less grace Chose, par-doned, and a-dopt-ed me; My Rest, my Home, my Dwell-ing place: Fa-ther, I come to Thee.

lines: God of my life, Thy boundless grace
My Rest, my Home, my Dwelling-place:
Jesus, my Hope, my Rock, my Shield,
Whose precious blood was shed for me,
Into Thy hands my soul I yield:
Spirit of glory and of God,
Long hast Thou deigned my Guide to be;
Now be Thy comfort sweet bestowed:
My God, I come to Thee.
I come to join that countless host
Blest Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
My God, I come to Thee.

licence: Public domain: Charlotte Elliott died in 1871.
credits: Words by Charlotte Elliott (1789–1871), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to JUST AS I AM by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
